attributes.residual: real 8, of which the blocking half is the island immediate at +0x17c: target `addi r3,r31,32`, ours `addi r3,r31,24`, the same +8 delta the chart flagged, and -- decisively -- with the frames ALREADY EQUAL at 72 and the save sets already equal at `stmw r28,56(r1)`. That is precisely the configuration the geometry law rules out: raising the island by 8 requires an 8-aligned dead local, which necessarily adds 16 frame bytes, so the immediate cannot be closed while the frame must stay put. The measurement above is the direct demonstration on THIS function rather than an inference from fn_800D9C5C's harness. The other half is a three-atom epilogue permutation, ours `O[105:108]@1a4-1b0=['li','stw','lwz']` against target `T[106:109]@1a8-1b4=['stw','li','lwz']`, opcode multiset IDENTICAL at 113/113. CLASSIFICATION: BLOCKED, same family and same wall as fn_800D9C5C -- a source-unreachable island immediate plus a permutation that is barred from mattering because the immediate is an operand difference the Mandatory result policy keeps out of the postprocessor path. DO NOT RETRY the pad axis, the 8-aligned-dead-local axis, or any local-declaration reshaping: the frame-cost coupling is measured, here and in the 1296-shape lattice. The prior record attempt.MD_fn800d96b0-island-ternary-guard-drive.20260901.v1 (outcome improved) remains correct on its own axes and is NOT superseded; this record caps the island axis specifically.
